app.name: METO Movement app
app.oneLiner: The free home of the Way of Remembering, on the web or as a phone app. People watch 13 module films, do the activities, join the Circle and apply for the January 2027 pilgrimage.
app.status: Live. The redesign went up Sep 14-15. The four-part curriculum, the Fa study cards, the facilitator dashboard and the Remembrance Map were added Sep 26-27. All 50 public pages loaded without errors on Sep 27.
app.builtWith: Built and hosted on Higgsfield, with its own database for accounts, progress and applications. It installs as a phone app straight from the browser. There is no App Store or Google Play listing yet.

facts.label: documents to read on the site, plus 12 PDFs in English and French
sites in 23 states on the Remembrance Map
places, with their films still to come
real sign-ups or applications yet (one team test account)

journey.label: Sees a movement post
journey.detail: A METO or @dromavi collab post ends with the call to action: sign up for the free curriculum.

journey.label: Lands on the home page
journey.detail: Enroll Free and Apply for Pilgrimage sit at the top. Which web address posts should name is still open.

journey.label: Enrolls free
journey.detail: Name, email and password. Phone, city and how they heard are optional. A source tag shows where they came from.

journey.label: Starts Module 1
journey.detail: Watches the film, does the activity, writes a private reflection and takes a five-question quiz.

journey.label: Keeps the habit
journey.detail: Daily check-in and streak, the journal, the Circle feed, live prayer circles, Fa cards and the Remembrance Map.

journey.label: Puts the app on the phone
journey.detail: An install invitation appears after nine seconds. Installed, it gets a bottom tab bar.

journey.label: Applies for the pilgrimage
journey.detail: A free application with a saved reference number. Scholarship and ambassador forms sit alongside it.

journey.label: Team follows up
journey.detail: The admin reviews each application. Facilitators see every participant's progress. Online sessions start mid-October.

openQuestions: Where should Instagram traffic land? The spoken call to action names metomovement.com, but the curriculum lives at meto-movement.higgsfield.app. The team has no access to the domain settings, so it cannot point metomovement.com at the app yet.
12 or 13 modules? The Sep 25 plan counts 12 weekly sessions back from January. The app has 13 modules in 12 chapters, with two modules in Chapter 1. How should the weekly schedule handle that?
The home page and the CTA video A script call it 'a free, year-long curriculum.' The Sep 25 plan runs 12 weekly sessions from mid-October to January. Which should the site and the ad say?
Who should be the admin, and which accounts should be facilitators before sessions start mid-October? Facilitators need about two weeks to review first. As of Sep 27, no facilitator is set up.
Per-module sign-off on the 13 films is still open as of Sep 24. When can Dr. Bailey sign off?
Nine videos (about 2 h 45 min) exist only inside the Teachable player, including a star how-to. Who can save them before Teachable is retired?
The home and pilgrimage pages use pilgrim photos. As of Sep 6 no signed photo release existed. Can consent be confirmed before a wider launch?

The five-steps tracker on the curriculum and account pages ties each step to modules in a fixed order, with Recognition first. Earlier guidance says the steps are never numbered and their order is disputed. Pages also mix the spellings 'Rehumanization' and 'Re-Humanization'. Does Dr. Bailey approve?
What does the client mean by a news section: movement updates, pilgrimage announcements, or something else?
The Pilgrimage and Projects pages now say the Door of Return is in Agbanakin, and Projects spells it 'Akbanankin'. The Sep 14 build rule was never to name its location. Confirm the wording.

Seats: the Pilgrimage page already says 'A cohort of fifty.' Once applications arrive, it will also show how many seats are not yet spoken for, since applications under review count as taken. The Sep 14 build rules said no seat counts. The Q4 Playbook keeps the seat count internal and uses 'fifty people' as the group size only once Dr. Bailey approves that framing. Keep either line?
The trip fund on My learning shows a preset dollar goal until a pilgrim sets their own. The Sep 14 build rules said no prices on the site. Keep the preset, or start blank?
The About page says PROMETRA has chapters in 28 countries. Module text says 28 chapters in 2016 and more than 25 today. Which is right?
The four Metologist profiles on Consult came over from the earlier client build. Are they current?
Should online giving be switched on? The Donate page shows a provider button only when a donation link is set up.
Has Nehanda sent her review of the web app? The Sep 25 recap says she would review it offline.
A Sep 6 plan for a separate course site (12 modules, 63 lessons) was never built. Is it retired now that the live app has the four-part curriculum?
Stay with the installable web app, or go ahead with App Store and Google Play listings?
